passive.name: Organic Deconstruction
passive.text: Vel'Koz's abilities apply Organic Deconstruction to enemies on hit. If 3 stacks are accumulated, the enemy will take a burst of true damage.

spells.name: Plasma Fission
spells.text: Vel'Koz shoots a bolt of plasma that splits in two on reactivation or upon hitting an enemy. The bolt slows and damages on hit.

spells.name: Void Rift
spells.text: Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void that deals an initial burst of damage, then explodes for a second burst of damage after a delay.

spells.name: Tectonic Disruption
spells.text: Vel'Koz causes an area to explode, knocking up enemies, and knocking close enemies slightly away.

spells.name: Life Form Disintegration Ray
spells.text: Vel'Koz unleashes a channelled beam that follows the cursor for 2.5 seconds that deals magic damage. Organic Deconstruction Researches enemy champions causing them to take true damage instead.

damage.value: Vel'Koz deals magic damage with his channeled R and burst true damage when Organic Deconstruction reaches three stacks.

axis.value: Vel'Koz can favor lane kill pressure by maxing Plasma Fission or wave control by maxing Void Rift.

winCondition.value: Vel'Koz wins by poking enemies down before fights and sieging turrets.

spikes.why: Vel'Koz gains burst and kill potential.
Vel'Koz triggers a burst of true damage.

bait.why: When Vel'Koz spends his knockup, its 12-to-10-second cooldown leaves an enemy a window before he can use it again.

mistakes.value: Vel'Koz risks dying when he moves too close to threats.
